doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

title: Starting trumpet; Celestin, Armstrong and Kid Rena as idols
summary: McNeil began about age 15, around 1931, listening to Papa Celestin, Armstrong and Kid Rena on truck-bed ad tours.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well when you started out on trumpet here in the city, what age were you?
Oh I was about 15 or 16. 15, making 16, about 15 years old.
Well who were the big men in the trumpet playing line?

In that time? One of the big men in those days in the trumpet line was the great Papa Celestein. He had a wonderful band at that time. And actually my idol, the great Louis Armstrong, was just about, you know, reaching his peak at that time. Did you listen to the record? You know, you remember Ken Rayner? I knew him. Yeah, well I used to listen to him. You know, I was very much inspired by him to be, on Sundays, this time of evening, you'd find them, they'd have a dance on Mondays, but they'd advertise it on Sundays and the bands would go around and they'd stop on the different corners and it'd really blow back. And sometimes two bands would meet up on these trucks, that's where this tailgate stuff came in, a lot of it. Tramon was sitting on the back of the truck where he could really get away with, you know, vamping slide. And Kid Rayner was one of the greats, you know, in that time. He used to, like Louis Armstrong said, he'd get down there and cut your head with that jazz, see. And he was one of the best head cutters for that stuff in my time. Because Loris and those boys had moved out, you know, and really had hit the big times. And Rayner was one of the greats that never did, you know, leave New Orleans and really go into the big, you know, big music award.
I can remember him not as well as, you know, some of the others.
Well, he died in 31, you know, so. Yeah. Right on there, so he'd be gone just about the time you were starting.
The time I was starting, yeah. So I started around 33, 32, around 31, around that time. Yeah.
